newsitem.title: USA: Whitehead reappointed N.Y. Fed chairman.
newsitem.headline: Whitehead reappointed N.Y. Fed chairman.

text.p: The New York Federal Reserve Bank said on Tuesday that the Federal Reserve's Board of Governors redesignated John Whitehead as chairman of the New York Federal Reserve Bank's board of directors and Federal Reserve Agent for 1997.

Whitehead, former Deputy Secretary of State and currently chairman of AEA Investors Inc., also has been reappointed a class C director for a three-year term beginning January 1997 by the Board of Governors, the New York Federal Reserve Bank said.

The Board of Governors also redesignated Thomas Jones as deputy chairman of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's board of directors for the coming year. He has been serving as a Class C director and deputy chairman since January 1996.
Jones is vice chairman, president and chief operating officer of the Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association- College Retirement Equities Fund.
